source_anchor: AppendixB2.2 actual centered-Gaussian signed test expectation H through Eq21, with genuine pointwise Gaussian/test weighted-volume L1, exact law-to-density integral transport and genuine outer Haar L1. Existing literal transform is consumed; determinant-conditioned target-mixture construction, H-to-TV and sphere/Poisson/main lower bounds remain separate.

proposed_signatures.actual_gaussian_transform:
theorem actual_gaussian_transform {n : ℕ} (hn : 3 ≤ n) {κ : ℝ}
    (hκ : 4 ≤ κ) {ℓ : ℝ} (hℓ : 0 ≤ ℓ) :
    let j0 : Fin n := ⟨0, lt_of_lt_of_le (by decide : 0 < 3) hn⟩
    let U : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ :=
      fun O => (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ) j0 j0
    let a : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → ℝ :=
      fun O => κ + 1 + 4 * ℓ - (κ - 1) * U O
    let p : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ :=
      fun O x => Real.sqrt (singleBlockPrecision κ O).det /
        (2 * Real.pi) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) *
          Real.exp (-((WithLp.ofLp x) ⬝ᵥ
            (singleBlockPrecision κ O *ᵥ WithLp.ofLp x)) / 2)
    let t : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n) → ℝ := fun x => Real.exp (-ℓ * ‖x‖ ^ 2)
    let γ : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ → Measure (EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n)) :=
      fun O => ProbabilityTheory.multivariateGaussian (0 : EuclideanSpace ℝ (Fin n))
        (singleBlockPrecision κ O)⁻¹
    (∀ O, Integrable t (γ O) ∧ Integrable (fun x => t x * p O x) volume ∧
      (∫ x, t x ∂γ O) = ∫ x, t x * p O x) ∧
    Integrable (fun O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ =>
      (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * (∫ x, t x ∂γ O)) (orthogonalHaar n) ∧
    (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
      (O : Matrix (Fin n) (Fin n) ℝ).det * (∫ x, t x ∂γ O) ∂orthogonalHaar n) =
      ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (n - 1) * (Real.sqrt κ - 1) ^ (n - 1) /
        (2 : ℝ) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)) *
        (∫ O : Matrix.orthogonalGroup (Fin n) ℝ,
          ((Real.sqrt κ + 1) * U O - (Real.sqrt κ - 1)) /
            (a O) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2) ∂orthogonalHaar n)

meaning_definitions.orthogonalHaar: Identical actual normalized full real O(n) Borel Haar probability, both determinant signs.
meaning_definitions.gaussian: Existing canonical Mathlib multivariateGaussian zero covariance A_O^-1, already identified with exact p_O volume density by the same compiled GaussianLawDensity.gaussian_law_eq_density; no new Gaussian constructor.
meaning_definitions.p: Literal exact real density in signature; its positivity and measurability must be produced internally, not supplied as public premises.
meaning_definitions.test: Actual bounded continuous test exp(-ell*true Euclidean norm(x)^2), ell>=0 including zero. Its Gaussian L1 and density-weighted Euclidean-volume L1 are theorem outputs.
meaning_definitions.integrals: Actual real Bochner integrals on the displayed Gaussian, canonical Euclidean volume and full Haar probability. Integrable is genuine absolute L1; no use of default nonintegrable values to justify the expectation.
